## Theming: What's the point?

Race against time to repair a failing spaceship before it is consumed by a black hole.

### Solo pressure

The theme is a real-time emergency: decisions must be made before time runs out, not after a leisurely optimisation.

## Setting up: How to get started?

A verified official rulebook was unavailable when this page was prepared. Follow the physical rulebook for system, card, and timer setup.

### Prepare before starting the timer

Read and arrange every component required by the physical rulebook before time begins. Do not start a real-time game while still interpreting setup.

## Rounds and Phases

A verified official rulebook was unavailable. This is a real-time solo game, but this page does not specify the order in which systems are repaired or cards are resolved.

### Rules question protocol

Agree before the timer starts how to handle a rules question: pause only if the physical rulebook permits it, otherwise make the fastest reasonable reading and continue.

## Scoring

The central outcome is whether the ship is repaired before the timer expires. Consult the physical rulebook for its exact win, loss, and any performance conditions.

### Do not add a score

No verified source supports an additional score or ranking procedure here.

## Terminology

**Systems**: parts of the ship requiring repair. **Timer**: the real-time pressure. **Black hole**: the impending failure represented by the timer.

### Repair

Use the physical rulebook's definition of a completed repair; visual intuition is not a rules test.
